title: Toward Maximizing Algebraic Connectivity via Density-Dependent Backbone Construction and Reinforcement Learning Completion
abstract: arXiv:2610.12697v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper studies an open network design problem of constructing graph topologies with maximum algebraic connectivity under fixed numbers of vertices and edges. A density-dependent approach is proposed that decomposes the design task into two stages: a high-quality, low-cost structural backbone construction and a reinforcement learning completion stage. The method selects the backbone based on density, using complete multipartite graphs in dense regimes and Cayley graphs in low-to-intermediate regimes, and then refines the remaining edges through a learning-based procedure. Numerical results show that the proposed method achieves high algebraic connectivity with favorable runtime scalability, outperforming existing methods. These results support a structural-family-first strategy for scalable network design.

translated_title: 基于密度依赖骨架构建与强化学习补全的代数连通度最大化研究
translated_abstract: 本文研究了一个开放的网络设计问题，即在顶点数和边数固定的条件下，构建具有最大代数连通度的图拓扑结构。文章提出了一种基于密度的方法，将设计任务分解为两个阶段：高质量、低成本的骨架结构构建阶段和强化学习补全阶段。该方法根据图的密度选择骨架，在稠密情形下使用完全多部图，在低到中等密度情形下使用凯莱图，然后通过基于学习的过程来完善剩余的边。数值结果表明，所提出的方法能够实现较高的代数连通度，且运行时间具有良好的可扩展性，优于现有方法。这些结果支持了一种面向可扩展网络设计的“结构族优先”策略。
tldr: 提出一种密度依赖的两阶段方法——先依据密度选择完全多部图或凯莱图作为骨架，再用强化学习补全剩余边——在固定顶点和边数条件下高效构建代数连通度最大的图拓扑，性能优于现有方法且运行时间可扩展性良好。
en_tdlr: A density-dependent two-stage approach—constructing a structural backbone using complete multipartite graphs or Cayley graphs based on density, then completing remaining edges via reinforcement learning—efficiently builds graphs with maximum algebraic connectivity under fixed vertex and edge budgets, outperforming existing methods with favorable runtime scalability.
